name: Ecomark Scheme of India (ECOMARK)
benefit:
- The scheme grants an Ecomark label to the product.
- The Ecomark granted to the product shall be valid for a period of three years or until a change in the Ecomark criteria for the product, whichever is earlier.

##### ***Conditions***

- Every holder of Ecomark shall submit an annual report to the Central Pollution Control Board online through the web portal on or before the 31st May of every y
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a producer, manufacturer, exporter, or importer of products specified under the First Schedule of the rules. - The applicant must have a license or a certificate of conformity of Indian Standards granted under the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016. - The applicant must comply with the mandate of the Quality Control Orders issued by the Central Government, if applicable. - The applicant must fulfill the criteria for the grant of Ecomark specified under the corresponding entries of the First Schedule.
